about:
Founded in 2001, ICB Electronics, Inc. is based in Scottsboro, Alabama, where it operates a manufacturing facility on South Broad Street. The business serves manufacturers throughout the South and is led by Jack O’Rear as the primary point of contact.

ICB Electronics produces cable and wire harness assemblies with a focus on high-mix, low-volume orders. Processes cover wire stripping, cutting, marking, hand soldering, and small box builds. The shop runs a KOMAX Gamma 333pc and a Cosmic 60R automatic wire processing machines, supported by a range of die sets. The quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 for the manufacturing and testing of cable and harness assemblies.

The product range includes power distribution cables, coaxial cables, communication cables, industrial cables, ribbon cables, and individual cable assemblies. Customers are primarily manufacturers in the southeastern United States who need flexible, high-mix harness production.

The company describes its mission as changing the future of harness manufacturing through creative manufacturing solutions. It emphasizes that a truly flexible vendor ensures usability, longevity, and vibrant product response in changing markets.
